news.headline: Abivax Earnings Are Imminent: Most-Accurate Analysts' Forecasts Ahead of the September 21 Call
news.summary: With Abivax's H1 2026 report due after the close on Monday, September 21, Benzinga surveyed top-rated analysts' pre-print positioning: consensus calls for a loss of about $1.08 per ADS on roughly $1.86m of revenue. Recent target moves cited include Jefferies' Faisal Khurshid (Buy, $158), Piper Sandler's Allison Bratzel (Overweight, $175) and Wedbush's David Nierengarten (Neutral, $110), with the broader 10-analyst consensus target near $155.

news.headline: Goldman Sachs Initiates Abivax at Buy With $155 Price Target
news.summary: Goldman Sachs started coverage of Abivax's ADSs at Buy with a $155 target, calling obefazimod a potential "multiblockbuster" and modeling roughly EUR4bn in peak ulcerative colitis sales plus EUR3.5bn in Crohn's disease sales pending 2027 Phase 2b data. Shares rose about 3% to a session high near EUR105 on the initiation, with Goldman also flagging Abivax as a plausible acquisition target while noting solo U.S. commercialization is viable post-raise.

news.headline: Euronext Announces 2026 Annual Review Results of the CAC Family
news.summary: Euronext's annual index review left the composition of the CAC 40, CAC Next 20 and CAC Large 60 unchanged, effective after the close on September 18, 2026, meaning Abivax retains the CAC Next 20 and CAC Large 60 membership it won in the June 2026 quarterly review rather than stepping up further this cycle. The unrelated biotech Genfit was instead the notable addition, joining the smaller CAC Mid 60 and SBF 120 indices.

news.headline: STAT: The Drugmaker Abivax Has Still Not Been Acquired. What's Going On?
news.summary: STAT's Adam Feuerstein examined why, nine months into a record biotech M&A year in which a roughly $20bn takeout of Abivax was widely treated as imminent, no deal has materialized, to the visible frustration of the shareholder base. The piece recaps the reported Eli Lilly approach (~EUR15bn, January 2026) and the AstraZeneca data-room exclusivity story (March 2026) and frames the delay as timing and process rather than a broken thesis, noting obefazimod's blockbuster commercial potential in ulcerative colitis remains intact.

news.headline: Abivax Named Among Three Top Immunology Takeover Targets in PharmaVoice Dealmaking Analysis
news.summary: PharmaVoice profiled Abivax alongside Spyre Therapeutics and MoonLake Immunotherapeutics as one of immunology's most talked-about M&A candidates, citing the ABTECT maintenance data (37% clinical remission and 48% endoscopic improvement at Week 44 among induction non-responders on 50 mg) and a roughly $25bn addressable IBD market by 2030. It notes CEO Marc de Garidel dismissed earlier 2026 Eli Lilly acquisition rumors as noise, and that the $920m July offering funds the company into 2029, reducing the urgency for a near-term sale.

news.headline: ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 Review: Obefazimod Sustains Week-44 Remission With No Dose-Dependent Malignancy Signal
news.summary: A clinical review of the Phase 3 ABTECT Part 2 maintenance package confirmed that 37.2% of induction non-responders reached clinical remission and 34.5% endoscopic remission at Week 44 on continued 50 mg obefazimod, and that dose escalation to 50 mg recaptured clinical remission in 45.5% of patients who had relapsed in Part 1. Crucially for the June malignancy overhang, the expanded exposure showed malignancy and non-melanoma skin cancer rates consistent with UC background rates and no apparent dose-dependent signal.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax's published financial calendar fixes this date (after market close on Monday, September 21), now less than a week out and the next confirmed company communication. Consensus (per Benzinga's September 14 preview) expects roughly a $1.08 per-ADS loss on ~$1.86m revenue. The report will show the first post-raise balance sheet (cash was EUR491.6m at March 31, 2026 before the $920m July offering, with runway now guided into 2029) and the step-up in R&D and pre-launch commercial spend. Expect a business update on NDA preparation, EMA filing timing and the U.S. commercial build-out, plus management's first chance since the September 3 STAT piece and the September 10 Goldman Sachs Buy initiation to address the M&A question directly.

catalysts.label: Full ABTECT maintenance dataset at an autumn gastroenterology congress (UEG Week / ACG)
catalysts.detail: Abivax presented two ABTECT induction late-breakers at UEG Week in Berlin in October 2025 and has a consistent pattern of taking full datasets to autumn congresses. A detailed public presentation of the Week-44 maintenance efficacy and, above all, the complete malignancy and safety database would be the cleanest way to fully retire the June cancer-signal overhang. No venue, abstract acceptance or presentation date for a 2026 autumn congress has been announced yet.

catalysts.label: NDA submission to FDA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: After positive Phase 3 ABTECT induction data, the 44-week maintenance readout, the Part 2 refractory-patient dataset and the constructive pre-NDA meeting on July 30, 2026, Abivax plans to submit its first NDA for obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active UC in late Q4 2026. This is the single biggest near-term de-risking event and the gate that starts the FDA review clock. Goldman Sachs's September 10 initiation explicitly built its $155 target around this filing proceeding on schedule; the September 21 H1 results call is the next scheduled opportunity for a timeline update.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax's financial calendar lists Q3 2026 results for December 14, 2026. By then the FDA submission should either have happened or be days away, so the release is the natural venue for confirming the NDA filing and giving first guidance on review type and expected PDUFA timing. It also lands roughly three months before the March-2027 option expiry, making it the last scheduled financial update inside the option's life.

catalysts.label: MAA submission to the EMA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Abivax guided to filing a Marketing Authorization Application in Europe in the second half of 2026, contingent on the (now positive) 44-week maintenance data. Recent communication has emphasised the Q4 2026 FDA filing without restating a precise EMA date, so exact MAA timing remains unconfirmed and could slip into H1 2027. A European filing would open the second-largest UC market and is a lower-drama but real value step; the September 21 H1 report is the likely place for an update.

catalysts.label: Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD Crohn's disease 12-week induction topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline results from the Phase 2b induction trial of obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active Crohn's disease are guided for mid-2027 (first patient enrolled October 2024). Management has explicitly pushed this from an earlier late-2026 expectation. Goldman Sachs's September 10 initiation modeled roughly EUR3.5bn in peak Crohn's sales contingent on this readout, making it the main pipeline diversification event, though it likely lands near or just after the March-2027 option expiry.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval decision and U.S. launch of obefazimod
catalysts.detail: With a Q4 2026 filing and a standard review cycle, an FDA decision would fall roughly 10-12 months later, i.e. in H2 2027, after the March-2027 call expiry. No PDUFA date exists yet because the NDA has not been submitted. The commercial organisation being hired since July 2026 is being built against this window, making it the ultimate approval and revenue catalyst for the equity.

pulse: No new company-specific catalyst has emerged since the September 10 Goldman Sachs Buy initiation ($155 target) and unchanged CAC index status; the main development this week is Benzinga's September 14 pre-earnings survey showing a ~$155 average 10-analyst price target and consensus estimates of roughly a $1.08 per-ADS loss on ~$1.86m revenue ahead of H1 2026 results, due after the close on Monday, September 21 (now under a week away). The dominant narrative remains the September 3 STAT piece asking why a company widely expected to be acquired for around $20bn (Eli Lilly's reported ~EUR15bn January approach, AstraZeneca's March data-room exclusivity) remains independent nine months into a record M&A year, sharpened by the $920m July raise that funds a solo U.S. launch into 2029 and reduces seller urgency, even as PharmaVoice still lists Abivax among the sector's top takeover candidates. All eyes now turn to the September 21 H1 results, where management should update on the Q4 2026 NDA filing timeline, EMA MAA plans and cash runway, and will likely face direct questions on the stalled M&A speculation.
